skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Reed picked this attire when she left Rhodes Island's Southern Victoria Office.
Paired with a versatile cloak for traversing the wilderness, it is a complete break from the Dublinn style.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Fire continues to burn at her spear tip. She hopes she can warm the long, cold night.
Rhodes Island's fireproof material is highly reliable, even in the heat of battle.

skins.name: Curator
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Curator. Scholar's garb straight from a fairy tale. Stuff your magic, knowledge, and curiosity in the pockets, and take notes with Reed.
skins.usage: One of Reed the Flame Shadow's casual outfits.
skins.quote: 'You know that every collection has its own fairy tale. That's part of its history.'

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA075
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA075. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.usage: One of Reed the Flame Shadow's summer outfits.
skins.quote: The blazing sun treads the waves, the flame shadow cleanses the heart.

skins.name: Glowing Flame in the Night
skins.content: Reed the Flame Shadow's festive attire/Glowing Flame in the Night. Don a white sweater and thick boots, drape yourself in a red cloak, heft up bundles of presents and brightness, then step into the tranquil night sky.
skins.usage: One of Reed the Flame Shadow's casual outfits.
skins.quote: To warm hearts and show the road ahead. Her light now shines for this purpose.
